_about: DRAFT wordings for a court disclosure of generative AI use. Every option is a draft that needs attorney approval before any use. None has been reviewed by an attorney. Bracketed text is a placeholder the attorney must replace.

options.label: Short notice
options.text: Generative artificial intelligence was used in preparing this document.
options.notes: Shortest form. Says nothing about how the tool was used or what was checked.

options.label: Notice with description of use
options.text: Counsel used generative artificial intelligence to assist in preparing this document, specifically for [describe use]. Counsel reviewed all AI-assisted content.
options.notes: Describes the use. The bracketed description must be filled in for each filing.

options.label: Notice with verification statement
options.text: Counsel used generative artificial intelligence to assist in preparing this document, specifically for [describe use]. The undersigned attorney personally verified every citation in this document and reviewed and corrected all AI-assisted content before filing.
options.notes: Adds a factual statement about verification. Use only if the statement is true for the filing; the verification record should support it.

options.label: Footnote form
options.text: Disclosure of generative AI use: portions of this document were prepared with the assistance of generative artificial intelligence. The undersigned attorney reviewed the document in full and is responsible for its contents.
options.notes: Written to sit in a footnote or after the signature block. Placement is a choice for the General Counsel; see OPEN_QUESTIONS.md.
